d:
Koee aapse kahe ki aapko shanti banae rakhni hai, magar iske lie ek phorm bhi bharna hoga.
Ise kahte hain pis bond. par ye hota kya hai aur kin halat men pulis khud hi shikayat karti hai aur khud hi jaj ban jati hai?
Is vidiyo men yahi samajhne ki koshish karte hain.
Riport- vinit bhalla
Vidiyo- altaf
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
